title: A year of a household's electric bills and what changed
summary: Example monthly kWh and dollar data for one household, with notes on what actually moved the bill.

blocks.title: Twelve bills, and the few things that moved them
blocks.body: A temperate-climate household, electric heat pump + dryer, work-from-home two days a week. Numbers are illustrative so you can see season and behavior — not a utility quote.

items.title: Thermostat schedule tightened

items.title: Cooling season starts
items.detail: kWh rises with outdoor temperature more than with 'bad habits.'

items.title: Setpoint war

items.title: Remaining halogen bulbs replaced
items.detail: Small persistent cut; easy to overclaim vs weather.

blocks.heading: Signal vs noise on a household bill

columns.name: Usually dominates
columns.detail: Weather (heat/cool), occupancy, major always-on loads, rate changes.

columns.name: Easy to overthink
columns.detail: Phone chargers, one LED bulb, 'vampire' myth stacks that do not move a $120 summer bill.

blocks.title: How to use this shape
blocks.body: Export your own twelve months. Annotate the two or three real life events. If a month spikes without weather or guests, then hunt appliances — not before.
